The facts: Zhang gave kickbacks (bribes) to Liu and Huang, who are project comprehensive department deputy general manager and project engineering (supervision) deputy manager. He paid them money as return for helping him get contracts. This is bribery (giving bribes). The participants: Zhang is a contractor, giving bribes to public officials? They are employees of a private real estate development company (Fuding Biyu Garden). Are they public officials? They are corporate employees, not state functionaries. So the crime is "行贿" (bribery) but need to specify "单位行贿" maybe? Here Zhang is a natural person (maybe a business owner) giving bribes to corporate staff. That is "行贿罪" (bribery). The examples earlier: they used "行贿" for similar scenario where a person gave bribe to a company official. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.
